description: This file defines the class 'kintVariableData', which appears to be a data structure used for representing variable information in a debugging or dumping context, including metadata such as type, size, value, and extended representations. It also includes helper functions for string encoding detection and array analysis.

classes.name: kintVariableData
classes.description: A class representing detailed information about a variable, including its type, access level, name, operator, size, value, extended representations, and alternatives.

methods.name: _detectEncoding
methods.description: Detects the encoding of a given string, utilizing mb_detect_encoding if available, or defaulting to 'ASCII' or 'UTF-8'.

methods.name: _isSequential
methods.description: Checks if an array is sequential and zero-based, indicating a list-like structure.

methods.name: _strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string, using mb_strlen if available, otherwise strlen.

methods.name: _substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a string, utilizing mb_substr if available, otherwise substr.
